finding.claim: Broken authorization on the ban endpoint. require_admin() denies access by calling abort(403), which raises an HTTPException. The ban handler wraps that call in `except Exception`, which catches it and only logs a warning. Execution then falls through to do_ban(uid), so any authenticated non-admin user can ban arbitrary users. The unban endpoint does not catch the exception, so it is correctly protected.
finding.source: Any authenticated non-admin user sends POST /admin/users/<uid>/ban with an arbitrary uid. g.user.is_admin is falsy.
finding.sink: do_ban(uid), the privileged ban operation, at admin.py:20

trace.note: Route /admin/users/<uid>/ban accepts POST with an attacker-chosen uid
require_admin(g.user) is called for a non-admin user
abort(403) raises werkzeug HTTPException, a subclass of Exception
Only logs a warning; no re-raise and no return
do_ban(uid) runs anyway and returns ok=True

finding.guards_checked: The require_admin check exists but is neutralized by the broad except. There is no other decorator, before_request hook or middleware in the codebase. The unban route (admin.py:26) calls require_admin without a try/except, which confirms the ban route's handling is the defect. A minor side issue is that the log line writes g.user's name, which is user-controlled data.

verdict.guard_found: require_admin() at admin.py:9-11 aborts with 403, but ban() catches it with `except Exception` at admin.py:18. No before_request hook, decorator or middleware exists in the code (grep found none outside docs).
verdict.reason: At admin.py:17-20, abort(403) from require_admin (admin.py:11) is swallowed by `except Exception` (admin.py:18), which only logs, so do_ban(uid) at admin.py:20 runs for any non-admin caller, while unban (admin.py:26) lets the exception propagate.

verdict_facts.guard_found: require_admin (admin.py:9-11) aborts with 403 for non-admins, but the abort is swallowed by except Exception at admin.py:18; no decorator, before_request hook or other check exists (admin.py is the only file).
verdict_facts.reason: Any authenticated non-admin reaches do_ban(uid) at admin.py:20 because abort(403) raised in require_admin (admin.py:11) is caught by `except Exception` at admin.py:18, which only logs and does not re-raise or return. Line numbers in the candidate trace are off by one in places (the try is on line 16 and the call on line 17), but each step does what the candidate says.
